Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Hand and glove**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "Very closely associated". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Hand and glove"** means to be very closely associated, working in close cooperation, or in harmony with someone. (बहुत निकटता से संबंधित होना या सहयोग करना) • **Example: **The two companies worked hand and glove to deliver the best customer experience. • The correct meaning of the idiom **"Hand and glove"** is "very closely associated" (बहुत निकटता से संबंधित). • **Example: **The detective and his assistant were hand and glove in solving the mystery. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "Very closely associated". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Working in rivalry** (प्रतिद्वंद्विता में काम करना): • **Explanation:** This means competing against each other, which is contrary to the meaning of "hand and glove". • **Example:** The two teams were working in rivalry to win the championship. • **Option 2: Acting carelessly** (लापरवाही से कार्य करना): • **Explanation:** This refers to behaving in a careless or inattentive manner, which does not align with the idiom's meaning. • **Example:** He was acting carelessly and missed the important details in the report. • **Option 4: Openly suspicious** (खुले तौर पर संदेह करना): • **Explanation:** This means being openly doubtful or distrustful, which is unrelated to the meaning of "hand and glove". • **Example:** She was openly suspicious of his intentions during the meeting. 34:Ta3b, The correct answer is: **Yielding**.
